story_type: workers high on a launch pad lightning tower
hook: Two workers hanging off a launch pad lightning tower.
narration: Two workers in a small basket, hanging off a lightning tower at a NASA launch pad.
This is Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center. Its tallest towers stand nearly six hundred feet.
The last hurricane had stripped the old paint right off this one.
Wires from the tower tops run down to the ground at an angle, steering lightning away from the rocket.
So crews ride up the side and do the work by hand.
[short pause] Another worker stands on the very top.
outcome: The crew prepped the tower for a fresh coat of paint, far above the pad.

location_card.place: Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida

title: Hanging off a launch pad lightning tower
description:
Drone footage from May 2019 shows workers at NASA Kennedy's Launch Complex 39B preparing the lightning suppression system candlestick for new paint after a hurricane removed the old coat.
